title: Ask Sylvia to be my girlfriend
paragraphs: 4 weeks ago I met you at a Japanese bookstore and the moment I saw you, I immediately thought about how to rizz you up. 4 weeks later, I am writing about how I feel about you.
I always think about you, no matter what time of the day is.
A lot of the times I wonder about what you are doing, sometimes wonder about what you are feeling, and sometimes I just wish I am cuddling you.

Even though it's only been a month, I feel like I've gotten to know so many different sides of you. I've seen you happy, 傻笑, drunk, upset, and everything in between. Though I don’t think it can get worse than Halloweekend Friday night (LOL)

We are probably not going to agree on everything and probably will annoy each other sometimes, we will probably even have moments when we don't understand each other. But I want us to keep figuring things out together. And yes, I'll try my best to 哄你 when you're upset (even though sometimes I might need you to 哄我 too).
So keep coming back to this letter whenever you want. Because I hope that when you read it again months or years from now, you'll know that I meant every word.
closing: I like you a lot, like a lot a lot a lot
